title: Corrected jointly trained multimodal persistent computation with explicit q1/q2 entity semantics
question: Can a jointly trained multimodal persistent computational chain carry cross-modal information into later queries, selectively address persistent state, execute an operator choice, verify post-action outcome, and remain capable on held-out modality/operator/query compositions when q1 and q2 target entities are generated and represented consistently?

arms.name: no_memory
arms.intervention: zero persistent state immediately before q1

arms.name: shuffle_image
arms.intervention: permute image observations across entities while retaining the same episode payloads and query answers

endpoints.name: heldout_q2_accuracy_all_modalities
endpoints.role: primary — held-out q2 verified action accuracy with all modalities and persistent state

held_constant: text bits 0-3, image bits 4-7, audio bits 8-11
q1 always targets entities[0] and q2 always targets entities[1], which are distinct
q1/q2 operator and bit-index composition is represented exactly by the pre-action query tuple
held-out compositions are absent from TRAIN_COMBOS including commutative reverse-index forms
training RNG namespace and evaluation RNG namespace are disjoint
evaluation episodes are generated only after all training steps
controls are evaluated on the exact same episode objects within each seed
environment outcome enters only after the action
target answer is not an argument to model.query
entity-addressed successful post-action writes are preserved
no test outcomes or verifier targets are used for model selection

information_flow.pre_action: three complementary modality observations -> encoders -> shared representation -> persistent write -> query-conditioned read -> CASM -> action

decision_rule.condition: all integrity and information-flow checks pass, mean integrated held-out q2 accuracy >=0.80, and every seed q2 accuracy >=0.40
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that the corrected synthetic multimodal persistent-computation chain meets the registered primary capability criterion
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal understanding, scaling laws, AGI, or autonomous operator discovery

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but primary threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: the corrected integrated architecture does not meet the primary synthetic criterion
decision_rule.does_not_license: impossibility of PLM or any component

decision_rule.condition: q1/q2 entity consistency fails, held-out composition leaks into training, or pre-action answer/outcome is accessible
normal q2 > no_memory q2 on paired episodes
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that persistent state contributes to this benchmark

decision_rule.condition: normal q2 > shuffle_image q2 on paired episodes
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that image alignment contributes
decision_rule.does_not_license: individual modality necessity without unimodal diagnostics

leakage_rules: sample_episode returns q1 entity=entities[0] and q2 entity=entities[1]; the answer for each query is computed only from that query entity's payload
TRAIN_COMBOS excludes HELDOUT before any training sampling occurs
evaluation q1/q2 tuples are drawn only from HELDOUT after training
controls receive the same generated episode list and the same answer labels; only the registered intervention changes
model.query accepts only memory, entity, i, j and op; outcome is passed separately after action
no evaluation metric is used to tune architecture, seeds, heldout tuples, or training hyperparameters

provenance.predecessor_failure: q2 answer was generated from entities[1] while the query tuple advertised entities[0]; the model therefore answered one entity while being graded on another

scope: entity-slot addressing rather than semantic memory search
hypothesis: A correctly generated q2 query must address the same entity whose payload defines its answer; after this correction, the integrated chain should meet the registered held-out capability criterion without pre-action target leakage.
